notes: Fix MuMu CN/Global detection for custom install paths. Family detection no longer assumes a folder named MuMuPlayer is Global. Watchdog now reads each installation configs/install_config.json and registry uninstall metadata: MuMuPlayer identifies CN and MuMuPlayerGlobal identifies Global. Registry InstallLocation is also used to discover custom roots such as F:\MuMuPlayer, preventing CN 0 from being mislabeled Global 0 or colliding with real Global instances.
